args.text:
The batch has 8 runs, and all 8 were accepted.
Flagged (1): r05, summary_outlier. Its checks pass and the width-free ratio was used (plane sections not run). But its profile has a different shape from the batch: the largest flank difference has the opposite sign (−0.81 vs median 0.495 %/h, z −16), and its growth zone is shorter (674 vs 695 µm in every other run). The REGR peak (53.09 %/h) and its position (421 µm) match the batch, so this is not a faster or slower root.
Cleared (7): r01, r02, r03, r04, r06, r07, r08. Every check that was run passes, and their REGR peak, peak position, growth-zone length and flank differences match the batch. The width-free ratio of −0.04 in r04 and r07 is only 0.08 from the median. Its z of −1.99 is large only because the batch MAD is zero.
Common thread: only one run was flagged. The issue is in the shape of its velocity and strain-rate profile (opposite-sign flank difference, which points to a different curvature rate, and a shorter growth zone), not in a failed check or a remedy pattern.
